name: unstructured

UNSTRUCTURED_API_KEY.description: API key for the hosted Unstructured API. When unset, partitioning runs locally via the open-source library.

UNSTRUCTURED_API_URL.description: Base URL for the hosted API. Set alongside UNSTRUCTURED_API_KEY for SaaS or self-hosted deployments.

OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory to write partitioned JSON output into. Defaults to ./output.

notes: Document partitioning library — turns PDFs, DOCX, HTML, PPTX, etc. into structured elements (titles, paragraphs, tables, images). EXECUTOR tier with bounded blast radius (filesystem only). When UNSTRUCTURED_API_KEY is set, requests leave the host — review your data residency requirements first.
